candidate_relations.reason: Pemphigus erythematosus (Senear-Usher syndrome) is a hybrid disorder combining features of pemphigus foliaceus and lupus erythematosus. The DIF showing intercellular IgG/C3 in the upper epidermis (pemphigus pattern) alongside basement membrane zone deposition (lupus pattern), plus acantholytic keratinocytes on histology, are the defining features of the full composite diagnosis. 'Lupus erythematosus, cutaneous' captures only the lupus component and misses the pemphigus/acantholytic dimension that defines Senear-Usher syndrome.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Lupus erythematosus, cutaneous is a component/overlap entity within Pemphigus erythematosus (Senear-Usher syndrome), which is defined by the combination of pemphigus features AND lupus erythematosus features; the candidate captures only the lupus component

case_quality_flags: Classic Senear-Usher syndrome presentation with dual DIF pattern (intercellular + BMZ) and acantholysis; ANA 1:640 with negative specific lupus antibodies supports overlap rather than pure SLE/CLE
